answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a publicly verifiable charitable donation: to enrol you post a signed receipt from a vetted charity, cross-checked against that charity's own published ledger, and any duplicate receipt ID is rejected on-chain. Minting a garden of clones then costs one real donation each, so a swarm's budget sinks to its nadir while an honest joiner pays once. Standing pools like a calm lagoon only for agents whose giving is genuine and traceable.
